_doc: Ownership manifest for the mutation-authority campaign (plans 0042-0050). This is TOOLING/GOVERNANCE metadata, not sweepable game content, which is why it lives in tools/ and not data/. It is the SINGLE home for exact ownership facts: authority classes, protected fields, construction allowances, and temporary legacy writers. Code headers and systems docs point HERE; they must not copy these lists. Enforced by tools/validate_mutation_authority.gd, whose header documents the detected write forms and the known blind spots.

aggregates.summary: The Green anti-ship establishment: surviving launchers, permanent losses (IJFS and launch attrition), and temporary suppression, held as AntishipSystem rows plus the container-level projection the IJFS targets.

owned_models._doc: Owned model: EVERY mutable field must be classified below or the gate fails. Lifetimes: identity = fixed at construction; establishment = original strength; campaign = persists across turns; transient = reset each turn/crossing.

hosted_fields._doc: Fields this aggregate owns on a model SHARED with other aggregates. Only the listed fields are protected; GameStateData's remaining fields are claimed by plans 0044-0049.

construction_writers.why: load_systems() initialises FRESH, unpublished AntishipSystem rows from the grouping spec before anything holds them. It never accepts live establishment state.
